headings.rules: Must use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for text-3xl and above. DO NOT use generic Inter for headings.

labels_overlines.rules: Uppercase, tiny text (text-xs), tracking-[0.2em] (wide spacing). Use for 'CITY', 'AREA', 'AMENITIES' labels.

colors.rules: Use high contrast. Rely on 1px solid strokes or 2px Inner Glow instead of soft shadows. Avoid pure #000000 or #808080 (always tint slightly with cool/blue tones, e.g., Slate/Zinc). Do not use Teal or Purple.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid crisp borders (border-zinc-200) for structural division.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist tactical shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05). Hover states should feature slight lift (-translate-y-1) and crisp shadow.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only for sticky nav headers: bg-white/80, backdrop-blur-md, border-b border-zinc-200. NO complete transparency.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the hero section background to avoid 'digital flatness'.

component_name.buttons: Sharp rectangular or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Primary CTA (e.g., 'Book Gym'): bg-black text-white hover:bg-zinc-800. Accent CTA: bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700.
component_name.cards: Flat, 1px solid border (border-zinc-200), no default shadow. Padding: p-6 or p-8. Hover: subtle lift and shadow.
component_name.inputs: Shadcn UI defaults but with rounded-md, border-zinc-300, focus:border-black focus:ring-1 focus:ring-black.
component_name.qr_code_display: Generous padding (p-8), white background, centered layout with a crisp 1px border and slight shadow to ensure scannability.

grids.marketing: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid for landing pages. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, wide gaps (gap-8). Asymmetric spans.
grids.dashboards: MODE B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized. h-full stretch for analytics cards and bookings lists.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, p-16, py-24. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6/p-8) to prevent collision.
layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, inputs, labels. Avoid center-everything disease.

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must have clear hover state (e.g., hover:bg-black/90 hover:text-white). Transition specific properties, DO NOT use transition-all.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for lists and grid items (like gym search results).

accessibility.contrast: Text below 18px must have 4.5:1 ratio. Large text 3:1. Explicit text color on hover.
accessibility.focus: MUST have high contrast focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:outline-none).

media.rules: Zoom in. Use close-ups and bold focus on essential details to create intimacy. Use high-quality imagery for gym profiles.

3d_libraries.usage: Use minimalist visual graphs in dashboards (Recharts/Shadcn). Avoid heavy 3D unless for specific hero interactives (not strictly needed for clean marketplace). Stick to 2D tactical layout.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'Performance Pro' minimal color palette: #0A0A0A (Obsidian base for dark elements), #FFFFFF (White base), #007AFF (Volt Blue) as accent CTA color.
Setup 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body text via Google Fonts and map them in tailwind.config.js.
Implement Shadcn UI for forms, inputs, tables, but restyle them to have crisp 1px borders instead of the default soft Vercel aesthetic. Override default Shadcn radii if needed.
For the marketing/landing page, use custom raw HTML+Tailwind with generous spacing (py-24, gap-12). Avoid Shadcn layout sections for marketing pages.
For dashboards (User, Trainer, Gym, Admin), implement a High-Density Grid layout, utilizing every pixel. Remove massive paddings inside data tables.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms for automated testing (CRITICAL).
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays or sticky headers. Always apply a backdrop blur and background tint (e.g., bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md).
Use Lucide-react for all icons. Ensure line weight matches font weight (usually 1.5 or 2).
Ensure UI layout accounts for displaying a generated QR code clearly in the booking completion and details screens.
Mock data properly. Ensure places like Hyderabad, Bangalore, Guntur are used in location selectors.
Work with .js/.jsx files as specified. Do not use TypeScript extensions for frontend files unless strictly required by backend.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where content scrolls under.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner components are located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js`
